hook: Aravind Srinivas earned an undergraduate degree from the Indian Institute of Technology Madras before moving to the United States for a PhD in computer science at UC Berkeley, completed in 2021, where his research focused on reinforcement learning and self-supervised representation learning. After graduating he worked briefly as a research scientist at OpenAI and then at Google DeepMind. In August 2022 he co-founded Perplexity AI with Denis Yarats, Johnny Ho, and Andy Konwinski, building what the company calls an answer engine that searches the web in real time and returns cited, sourced responses rather than a list of links. As CEO, he has positioned Perplexity as a search-grounded alternative to traditional chatbots and search engines since the product's public launch in December 2022.
